rationale: AMTGFA/TGFA abbreviation-control item is useful and not the same as existing TGFA/GFA/AMBF calculation items.

proposed_question.code_citation: PD 1096, 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 705.1-705.2, PDF p.83.
proposed_question.text: A question asks for Allowable Maximum Total Gross Floor Area. Which abbreviation should control the computation?

rationale.correct: TGFA means Total Gross Floor Area. Section 705.1-705.2 governs allowable floor areas and TGFA limitation.

distractors.A: AMBF is the Section 704.4 building-footprint control, not total gross floor area.
distractors.C: FSEC is a Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance term, not the Rule VII area metric.
distractors.D: NPCP is the plumbing code, not the NBCP floor-area control.

rationale.takeaway: Do not swap Section 705 TGFA and Section 704.4 AMBF; both appear in development-control questions.
